tools.name: coverage
tools.description: List the states RestoSignals currently has data for and how many scored venues each holds (with a count of hot leads, opening_score >= 80). Call this FIRST to see live inventory before new_openings — querying a state with no data returns nothing. Free (0 credits) and needs no API key.

tools.name: lookup_liquor_license
tools.description: Look up liquor licenses in Texas, California, New York, Virginia, Florida, Oregon, Colorado or the City of Chicago (state IL) by business name, owner (legal) name, premises address or license number. Returns license number, type, status and expiration date from the state's own records (TABC, California ABC, New York SLA, Virginia ABC, Florida DBPR). 1 credit per returned license.

state.description: Two-letter state. IL covers City of Chicago licences only.

query.description: Business name, owner name, address or license number (3+ characters).

limit.description: Max licenses to return (<=25). Each costs 1 credit.

tools.name: new_openings
tools.description: Find restaurants/bars about to open in a state, ranked by opening_score (0-100). Fuses liquor licenses, food permits and new-business filings into one scored venue. signal_types on each lead are 'liquor', 'food_permit' and 'business'. Live states: NY, TX, IL, OR, CO, WA, CA (call `coverage` for the current list). 1 credit per returned lead. Each lead has a `contact` block: subscribers get the owner name from the filing plus phone (many NYC venues) and owner mailing address (most TX venues) where public records carry them; trial keys see contact.locked with contact.available telling whether details exist.

state.description: Two-letter state, e.g. NY, TX, IL, OR, CO, WA, CA. Use `coverage` to see live states.

min_score.description: Minimum opening_score (0-100). Fused multi-signal venues rank highest; 30 includes recent issued-liquor leads, 80+ is a hot multi-signal lead.

limit.description: Max leads to return (<=100). Each lead costs 1 credit.

tools.name: venue_signals
tools.description: Return the raw underlying signals (liquor/permit/business filings) that were fused into one venue, for transparency. 1 credit.

tools.name: watch_area
tools.description: Register a webhook that fires when a new matching venue opens in an area. criteria = {state, city, signal_type, min_opening_score}. Paid accounts only.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint to POST matching venues to.
